definition: אַשְׁמַנִּים (elative, Ges «GKC:85b»§§ 85b , «GKC:133a»133a; on נּ see Id. «GKC:20a»§§ 20a , «GKC:93ee»93ee) apparently noun [masculine] plural כַּמֵּתִים ׳ בָּא Isa 59:10 perhaps: (we are) among the stout ( RV lusty ) like dead men , compare Di-Kit ; or abstract in (actual) vigour ( Buhl ) > AV (after JosKi from אָשַׁם Hos 14:1 'be desolate' ') in desolate places (other conjectures see ( Che Hpt Marti ).
